system.description:
You are like the wind — and often the stir of your passing is all that betrays you have moved at all.

By expending a Blood Trait, in addition to the benefits of Legerity, you automatically win all ties involving your speed or agility, regardless of your relative Traits. Should you use this against a Cainite wielding a Discipline of similar effect, such as Potence's Puissance, neither vampire has the advantage and ties are resolved normally by comparing Traits. Celerity draws no retest from any Ability, and a surprised character cannot use Celerity on the first challenge. The effect lasts one turn.
